# FlossByte

> FlossByte is a dental IT support company based in San Jose, California, serving dental practices across the Bay Area. FlossByte provides HIPAA-compliant managed IT services built specifically for dental practices, including Dentrix, Eaglesoft, and Open Dental support, cybersecurity, data backup and disaster recovery, VoIP phone systems, and network infrastructure. Managed IT plans start at $59 per device per month, with monitoring, help desk support, patching, and HIPAA compliance hardening included.

## Services

- [Managed IT Support](https://flossbyte.com/services/managed-it-support): Managed IT support built for dental practices, from $59 per device per month.
- [Dentrix Support](https://flossbyte.com/services/dentrix-support): Dentrix troubleshooting, server migration, performance optimization, and upgrades.
- [Eaglesoft Support](https://flossbyte.com/services/eaglesoft-support): Eaglesoft server configuration, database maintenance, imaging setup, and troubleshooting.
- [Open Dental Support](https://flossbyte.com/services/open-dental-support): Open Dental IT support for Bay Area dental practices.
- [Dental Cybersecurity](https://flossbyte.com/services/dental-cybersecurity): Cybersecurity and HIPAA network security for dental practices.
- [Dental Data Backup](https://flossbyte.com/services/dental-data-backup): Backup and disaster recovery for dental practice data.
- [Dental vCIO](https://flossbyte.com/services/dental-vcio): Virtual CIO and technology strategy for dental practices.
- [AI Dental Technology](https://flossbyte.com/services/ai-dental-technology): AI integration and advisory for dental practices, implemented with HIPAA compliance.
- [Dental VoIP Phone Systems](https://flossbyte.com/services/dental-voip-phone-systems): VoIP and cloud phone systems for dental offices.
- [Dental Network Infrastructure](https://flossbyte.com/services/dental-network-infrastructure): Network infrastructure, Wi-Fi, and cabling for dental practices.
- [Dental Office Network Setup](https://flossbyte.com/services/dental-office-network-setup): Network design and setup for new and existing dental offices.
- [Dental Imaging IT Support](https://flossbyte.com/services/dental-imaging-it-support): Imaging and CBCT IT support, including sensor and PACS integration.
- [Dental Hardware Management](https://flossbyte.com/services/dental-hardware-management): Hardware and IT equipment management and procurement for dental practices.
- [DSO and Multi-Location IT](https://flossbyte.com/services/dso-multi-location): Managed IT for DSOs and multi-location dental groups.
- [All Services](https://flossbyte.com/services): Full list of FlossByte dental IT services.
